attributes.name: Clarity
attributes.description: Resistance to illusion and ability to discern Prism surface from Dark Quasar truth.

attributes.name: Empathy
attributes.description: Emotional attunement that deepens trust and affection in DSSM relationship physics.

attributes.name: Resolve
attributes.description: Steady nerve under Veil storms and Dark Quasar gravitational pressure.

attributes.name: Perception
attributes.description: Sensitivity to hidden paths, symbolic objects, and subtle shifts in NPC mirror roles.

attributes.name: Veil Attunement
attributes.description: Capacity to walk dreams, channel echoes, and survive liminal districts like The Hollow.

resonance_tiers.name: Surface Walker
resonance_tiers.description: Draining talk. The town turns away. Below 0.10 the voice fails to cross. At 0.00 the session ends.

resonance_tiers.name: First Light
resonance_tiers.description: Polite, guarded contact. A new session starts here. The plaza depth sentence appears at 0.45.

resonance_tiers.name: Veil Listener
resonance_tiers.description: Engaged talk: listening, a real question, an observation. Listening Wall still needs storm or quasar.

resonance_tiers.name: Quasar Tested
resonance_tiers.description: Vulnerable talk. Mira's name can show at 0.80 during quasar. Other road locks still apply.

resonance_tiers.name: Awakened
resonance_tiers.description: Intimate talk. The membrane is clear glass. A surge at or above 0.80 is damped, so this band stays rare. Not an understanding of the Veil.
